Score & Grade: 117 Closed Grade: Closed
Observations & Corrective Actions

1: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge and performs duties. This is a Priority Foundation item 2-103.11 (A)-(O), and (Q) - Person-In-Charge-Duties (Pf)(Repeat)
Person-in-charge is not assuring oversight of Food Safety activities such as cooking, cooling, holding, sanitizing, pest control, and keeping the general premises clean.

10: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible. This is a Priority Foundation item 5-202.12(A) - Handwashing Sinks, Installation-Minimum Temperature (Pf)(Corrected on Site)(Repeat)
Hand sinks did not have soap or paper towels available. Corrected on site: soap and paper towels were provided.

13: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated. This is a Priority item 3-101.11 - Safe, Unadulterated and Honestly Presented (P)(Corrected on Site)(Repeat)
Many foods in the 2-door freezer/cooler and the walk-in refrigerator were observed to have mold growing in or on them. Moldy foods were discarded.

16: Food contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized. This is a Priority item 4-602.11(C) - TCS Foods - Cleaning Frequency (P)
Food-contact surfaces (cutting boards) and utensils are not cleaned at a minimum of every 4 hours. Education provided.

22: Proper cold holding temperatures. This is a Priority item 3-501.16 (A)(2) - TCS Food, Cold Holding (P)(Corrected on Site)(Repeat)
Food in the reach-in prep table on the cook line requiring refrigeration that was held for more than 24 hours was observed to be above 41F for more than 4 hours. Corrected on site: education provided; foods out of temperature were discarded.

23: Proper date marking and disposition. This is a Priority Foundation item 3-501.17 - Ready-To-Eat TCS Food, Date Marking (Pf)(Repeat)
Ready to eat food requiring refrigeration and held for more than 24 hours was not date marked and discarded after 7 days as required by the code. Expired foods were discarded.

38: Insects, rodents and animals not present. This is a Core item 6-501.111(A-B), and (D) - Controlling Pests (C)(Repeat)
Dead cockroaches are not removed from the establishment often enough to prevent accumulation. There is evidence of a cockroach infestation. Harborage conditions in the back "garage" are not eliminated; several large, greasy containers of used cooking oil were observed stored next to the walk-in refrigerator. Person in Charge stated that they have a pest control operator that comes every 2 weeks.

41: Wiping cloths; properly used and stored. This is a Core item 3-304.14 - Wiping Cloths, Storage and Use Limitation (C)(Repeat)
Sanitizer solution for wiping cloths was below the required minimum concentration (50-100 ppm). Education provided.

55: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean. This is a Core item 6-501.12 - Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions (C)
Physical facilities were not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean; there is visible food debris in, around, and under refrigeration and cooking equipment, floor drain baskets, and visible grease buildup on the stainless steel around the hood. Education provided.
